title: Enumerate the complete matrix and gate live collection
description:
## Scope

Expand every model, dataset, selector, context size, draw, order, and target cell into a frozen preflight manifest. Display exact new/cache-hit request counts, token estimates labeled as estimates, unsupported cells, and optimization versus scoreboard budgets. Require a frozen preregistration, explicit collection confirmation, and a hard request ceiling.

## Definition of done

Fake engines count zero calls during preflight; integration specs prove the actual runner cannot exceed the approved ceiling including retries and cannot silently add matrix cells.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Enumerate the complete matrix and gate live collection
  Scenario: Required observable behavior
    Given a complete study plan and a fake engine that counts calls
    When preflight enumerates the matrix
    Then every eligible request is identified and the engine receives zero calls
```

## Companion-project coordination

- [Decision-Flywheel](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-91347c58-fd85-5e64-8b20-8179d723fa9f`.

These are cross-repository references; local Kanbus blocked-by relationships encode prerequisites within this repository.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Closing: definition of done met. Preflight enumerates the complete matrix with zero model calls (`preflight_test.py`), and the collector cannot exceed the approved ceiling including retries or add cells (`collector_test.py`). The selected-global defect noted above was resolved by freezing development winners before the scoreboard preflight (44e032d), and the ordering pre-ledger gate defect was fixed in fa37abb. Both live initial-study runs stayed within their approved ceilings. The ordering-specific gate is built but its study is deferred.
